title: Concertina rollout cheatpad and hourly signal notes (Apr 2026)
content:
Purpose:
This is a compact, operator-facing cheatpad for a concertina-style rollout of the inference routing change scheduled for Apr 2026. The doc is intentionally concise: 1 page for the timeline/checks, 1 page for hourly signal thresholds and PromQL snippets, and a short release-notes draft to paste into the release ticket. Use this during 72-hour watch after cutover.

Scope of change:
- Routing: add tiered fallback to smaller quantized variants for traffic spikes.
- Serving config: enable prefix-KV caching for routes /generate-chat and /embed-batch.
- Autoscaler hint: lower scale-up threshold for dedicated pools by 10% to absorb bursty load.

Quick rollout timeline (concertina pattern):
- T-72h (prep): dry-run smoke against staging, finalize canary cohort list (5 services), sanity PRs merged.
- T-24h (preflight): config baked, infra-ops handoff, alert subscriptions set, pager roster final.
- T-2h (soft open): 1% traffic rerouted to new policy for 30m (smoke).
- T+0 (start): expand to 5% for 60m.
- T+1h: expand to 20% for 90m.
- T+3h: expand to 50% for 2h.
- T+6h: expand to 80% for 3h.
- T+9h: full rollout (100%).
- T+72h: watchlift retrospective + rollback-ready until signoff.

Operator checklist (preflight):
- [ ] Confirm PRs merged and image tags present: release-scripts PR #221, serving-runtime tag v2.14.3.
- [ ] Confirm canary cohort roster in ENG-1843 and Slack #deploy-orchestra pinned message.
- [ ] Verify infra autoscaler policy applied to dedicated pools (diff command: infractl policies show canary-apply).
- [ ] Billing guard: rate-limit keys with quota alert set to 120% of current 24h baseline.
- [ ] Dry-run smoke passes (see smoke-run-2026-04-05.log).
- [ ] Attach fallback playbook and on-call matrix to release ticket.

Hourly signal snapshots (what to check every 15/30/60 minutes):
- Frontline KPIs (every 15m): p95 latency for /generate-chat, error-rate (5xx + 429), inference-token cost per 1k tokens. Thresholds: p95 > +30% -> stop expansion; error-rate > 0.5% absolute -> stop expansion; cost spike > +40% -> investigate caching.
- Stability KPIs (every 30m): throughput (rps), queue length on serving runtime, GPU utilisation per pool. Thresholds: GPU util > 95% sustained for 5m -> throttle traffic; queue length growth > 2x -> rollback to previous routing.
- Quality KPIs (every 60m): sample 200 chat responses from canary cohort, run eval set scoring (BLEU/ROUGE-ish surrogate and hallucination heuristics). Drop > 4% in quality -> flag and hold expansion.

PromQL / fetch snippets (copy into SRE shell):
- p95 latency (ms): rate(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/generate-chat"}[5m])) by (le))) * 1000
- 5xx error-rate: sum(increase(http_requests_total{status=~"5..",route="/generate-chat"}[5m])) / sum(increase(http_requests_total{route="/generate-chat"}[5m]))
- GPU util per pool: avg_over_time(gpu_utilization_percent{pool=~"dedicated-.*"}[5m])
- queue length: max_over_time(serving_queue_length{pool!=""}[5m])

Traffic expansion decision matrix (concertina steps):
- Expand if all: p95 delta <= +15%, error-rate change <= +0.1pp, GPU util < 85%, sample quality delta <= +1%.
- Hold if any: p95 delta between +15% and +30% OR GPU util between 85-95% OR quality drift between +1% and +4% -> wait 30-60m and recheck.
- Rollback if any: p95 delta > +30% OR error-rate increase > +0.5pp OR GPU util > 95% OR quality drop > 4% -> immediate rollback to previous routing.

Rollback commands (operator quick run):
- routingctl set-mode --route /generate-chat --policy previous-stable --commit "concertina rollback"
- infractl scale set --pool dedicated-foo --min 4 --max 12 --reason "rollback after rollout"
- Notify: post to #deploy-orchestra with subject: [ROLLBACK] Concertina rollout - route /generate-chat - reason: <short reason> and open quick incident in ENG-1843.

Communications (who to ping when):
- Pager: primary SRE on-call (see rotation).
- Escalation: Marcus Chen (serving-runtime) -> Priya Natarajan (platform-eng) -> Head of Eng if > 2h outage.
- Exec update: 1x sentence + impact metrics at T+3h and T+24h if unresolved.

Release notes draft (to paste into ENG-1843 before merge):
- Summary: introduce tiered fallback routing and enabled prefix-KV caching for chat and embeddings to reduce cold-start token cost and improve tail latency under burst.
- Risk: small chance of increased GPU contention in Dedicated pools; mitigations: conservative expansion, autoscaler adjustment, quick rollback commands.
- Rollout plan: concertina expansion from 1% -> 100% over 9 hours with 72h watch.
- Rollback plan: immediate rollback criteria listed in the operator cheatpad; contacts and runbook linked.
- Notes for support: attach canned queries (p95, 5xx, GPU util), sample failure patterns, and guidance for triage.

Open questions / followups (post-roll):
- Do we need a persistent prefix-KV warming job for long-tail customers?
- Should Optimize suggest per-route quantization profiles automatically when fallback is used?
- Capture canary traffic diffs for ML evaluation: schedule a 24h sample job and attach to model-evals.

Appendix: quick links
- Release ticket: ENG-1843
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-scripts/pull/221
- Slack deploy channel: https://slack.redwood/archives/C0DEPLOY (pinned: canary cohort list)
- Smoke logs: gs://redwood-smoke/smoke-run-2026-04-05.log

Notes to operator (voice):
If you see a flicker in p95 but no error-rate change, hold and let the caches warm for 30m. The main thing is to avoid oscillating expands/rollbacks; prefer holding to flipping. Be explicit in Slack about why you held/rolled back.

End of cheatpad.
